caption: Format Validation was switched on after three clicks in the onboarding, about 2 minutes after the install. The store name is hidden.
The plan step offers Minimal at $9.99 a month, with address validation and automatic correction crossed out, or Pro at $0.04 per order; both start with a 14 day trial. The store name is hidden.
Approving Minimal on our development store was a test charge: $9.99 every 30 days after a trial to 1 Dec, approved without a card. The store name is hidden.
Checking the address while the customer types needs Shopify Plus, so the switch stayed grey on our store. The store name and the address in the example card are hidden.
With Format Validation active, the in-app example blocks 5th Ave until a house number is added. We did not see it block a real checkout. The store name is hidden.
